question: Who among the following Indian classical musicians was the very first to be presented with the Bharat Ratna, India’s highest civilian honour?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madurai Shanmukhavadivu Subbulakshmi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Madurai Shanmukhavadivu Subbulakshmi **was an **Indian Carnatic singer from Madurai, Tamil Nadu**.
 
• She was the **first musician ever to be awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honor**.
